```sql
SELECT bowler,
       ROUND(total_runs::numeric / (balls / 6.0), 2) AS economy
FROM (
    SELECT d.bowler,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL 
                                 OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wide','no_ball')) AS balls,
           SUM(d.total_runs) AS total_runs
    FROM deliveries d
    JOIN matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.date >= DATE '2020-01-01'
      AND d.over_no BETWEEN 16 AND 20
    GROUP BY d.bowler
    HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.extras_type IS NULL 
                                 OR d.extras_type NOT IN ('wide','no_ball')) >= 200
) AS t
ORDER BY economy
LIMIT 1;
```
